roles.store: Content-addressed blob store: put, has and read by sha256 reference; atomic write and read-back verification
roles.cache-index: Cache index file inside a repository: cache key to artifact reference plus dependency paths, written under a lock
roles.gc: Garbage collection of unreferenced blobs: dry run by default, unexpected entries are reported and never deleted
roles.cache-key: Canonical JSON, sha256 digests and the scan cache key
roles.cache-runtime: Runs a computation through the cache: a hit returns the stored artifact, a miss computes, stores and indexes it
roles.file-index: Digest index of the files below a root, with count and byte budgets and portable path findings
roles.invalidation: Added, deleted, modified and dependency-invalidated paths between two file indexes
roles.legacy-cache: Shadow cache around the single-project scanner runScan, which it does not change
roles.performance-policy: Pass, fail or blocked verdict comparing a candidate measurement with a baseline measurement
roles.project-cache-plan: Per-project cache namespaces from the draft project graph, and the projects invalidated by a change
roles.project-cache-runner: Shadow run of the legacy cache for every planned project through the scheduler
roles.resource-budget: Memory admission derived from total memory, a reserve fraction and a minimum reserve
roles.scheduler: Dependency-aware task graph runner with a concurrency limit and a byte budget

ARTIFACT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.meaning: put refuses content larger than maxArtifactBytes and writes nothing

ARTIFACT_CORRUPT.meaning: stored bytes differ from the reference in size or digest, on read or on the read-back after a write; nothing is repaired

ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND.meaning: read of a reference whose blob is absent

INDEX_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.meaning: file count or byte count above maxFiles or maxBytes; no partial index is returned

PROJECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: the plan names an adapter that is not among the given adapters

PROJECT_GRAPH_ROOT_MISMATCH.meaning: the graph root is neither a dot nor the absolute execution root

PROJECT_GRAPH_STALE.meaning: a marker file changed after graph discovery; a marker that is missing or unreadable carries only code

DEPENDENCY_NOT_PASSED.meaning: a task named in dependsOn failed or was blocked, so this task never ran; the result names that dependency

RESOURCE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.meaning: estimatedBytes of the task alone exceed maxEstimatedBytesInFlight; the result carries estimated_bytes and budget_bytes

INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY_AFTER_RESERVE.meaning: nothing is left to admit after the reserve; status is blocked and admission_bytes is zero

MISSING_ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY.meaning: baseline or candidate environment lacks profile_id, platform, arch or node_major; the result holds this check alone

ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH.meaning: baseline and candidate environments differ; the result holds this check alone

WORKLOAD_SET_MISMATCH.meaning: a workload id exists on one side only

INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLES.meaning: fewer samples than minSamples on either side

SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENCE_UNPROVEN.meaning: semantic_equivalence is neither true nor false

MISSING_OR_INVALID_METRIC.meaning: a required metric is not a finite positive number

COLD_REGRESSION_PCT.meaning: candidate cold_p95_ms against baseline cold_p95_ms, limit maxColdRegressionPct

PEAK_RSS_REGRESSION_PCT.meaning: candidate peak_rss_bytes against baseline peak_rss_bytes, limit maxPeakRssRegressionPct

CACHE_HIT_FRACTION_OF_COLD.meaning: candidate cache_hit_p95_ms divided by candidate cold_p95_ms, limit maxCacheHitFractionOfCold

scheduler_task_status.of: each task result of the scheduler

legacy.sourceDigest: the source_digest of the file index of repoRoot
legacy.resolverDigest: digest of the mode legacy-single-project, cacheNamespace, the adapter id, rgAvailable and the constants include_db false and runtime_routes false
legacy.parserDigest: implementationDigest as given by the caller
legacy.adapterDigest: digest of implementationDigest and the adapter snapshot: contract, id, title, specificity, confidence, verification_basis and capabilities
legacy.schemaDigest: digest of the scan report schema string sbf.scan-report/2
legacy.policyDigest: digest of the contract tag t21-legacy-scan-shadow/1, policyFingerprint and the constants db disabled, runtime_routes disabled, cache_corruption fail-closed
legacy.runtimeFingerprint: as given; the default is node=VERSION;platform=PLATFORM;arch=ARCH of the running process

project: graph_schema, the schema string of the project graph
adapter_id, and mode: first-class from the selected adapter, fallback only when includeFallback is set
markers: path, kind and digest of each marker, sorted by path and kind
dependency_project_ids: only local-package-dependency edges, from the consumer to the dependency

excluded: symlinks, which are listed in skipped_symlinks and never followed
the absolute path of the root
the contents of a directory named in excludedDirs, at any depth

reachability.lifted: a reviewed consumer calls the layer behind a switch that is off by default, every reference outside the two directories is listed and classified, and the stable scan result is byte-identical with the switch off

suite-in-ci.lifted: the T21 suite runs in a required check or in the root test script, with the job names pinned to the commit under test

packed-import.lifted: a test packs the package, installs it in a scratch directory and imports every exported name of both directories, and the packed file list is recorded

timing.lifted: a measurement protocol is approved, measurements are taken at the exact commit for every adapter on the target hosts, the warm path is a real cache hit, and an approved service level objective is the input of the gate; until then the gate stays blocked

containment.lifted: containment is checked on resolved real paths, a copied tree cannot serve a report that embeds another tree, and the file index reads the directories the stable scan reads or the difference is the stated cache scope

retention.lifted: a stated policy retires superseded entries, collection and writers exclude each other under one lock with a clock the caller cannot choose, and the scheduler has a timeout and a cancellation path that a test exercises

project-graph-input.lifted: the owner of the project graph freezes its schema and this layer reads the frozen reference, with cache namespaces compared before and after

platform-coverage.lifted: the record is regenerated and compared on every platform the pipeline uses, and each difference is listed

promotion.lifted: an integration is reviewed and merged by its owner, and a rollback plan, a supported-scope record and approvable evidence exist (items T21-05 and T21-06 of the track plan)

non_gate_limits.fixtures-are-synthetic-inputs: the replayed inputs are small constructed trees and copies of pinned fixtures; the record never claims they represent real repositories, so nothing is promoted on them
non_gate_limits.installed-package-files-are-not-hashed: package-lock.json and the installed versions are recorded; hashing installed files would pin the machine, so the statement stays a limit
non_gate_limits.scenario-module-is-not-hashed: baseline-scenarios.mjs builds the replayed calls; the outputs it must reproduce are pinned, so a change to it matters only when an output changes

pinned_tests.t21-artifact-gc.test.mjs: dry run by default and reachable blobs never selected, apply deletes only unreachable age-qualified blobs, malformed entries reported and not deleted, deletion budgets
pinned_tests.t21-artifact-store.test.mjs: deduplication by exact bytes with verified reads, corruption detection, byte budget before write
pinned_tests.t21-benchmark-smoke.test.mjs: legacy-cache benchmark emits machine-readable semantic-equivalence evidence
pinned_tests.t21-cache-index.test.mjs: exact artifact refs and sorted listing, fail closed on corrupted state, path containment, two OS processes keep both entries, dependency invalidation
pinned_tests.t21-cache-key.test.mjs: determinism across key order, every dimension invalidates, malformed digests and ambiguous JSON refused
pinned_tests.t21-cache-runtime.test.mjs: miss computes once and a hit returns the same value, changed key recomputes, corrupt artifact fails closed, validation on misses and hits
pinned_tests.t21-file-index-invalidation.test.mjs: deterministic content-addressed index with excluded directories, transitive invalidation, global input drift, budgets fail closed, portability collisions
pinned_tests.t21-legacy-cache-equivalence.test.mjs: key changes with terms and implementation revision, missing implementation identity refused, project namespace changes the key and not the report, cached reports equal uncached ones per adapter fixture
pinned_tests.t21-performance-policy.test.mjs: memory admission reserve and cap, gate decisions for pass, fail and blocked inputs
pinned_tests.t21-project-cache.test.mjs: plan order and fallback exclusion, invalidation propagation, cache off, miss and hit, portable graph in another checkout, marker drift, policy fingerprint, corrupted cache, namespace change
pinned_tests.t21-scheduler.test.mjs: dependency order, concurrency and byte reservations, oversized task blocking, failure containment, graph refusals before work, metrics
